question: India won the inaugural edition of the SAARC Gold Cup Football held in 1993 in ___________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Lahore, Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India won the **inaugural edition** of the SAARC Gold Cup Football tournament held in **1993**.
 
• The event was hosted in **Lahore, Pakistan**, showcasing the significance of sports diplomacy within the SAARC region.
 
• The tournament was organized to foster **regional cooperation** and promote football among SAARC member nations.
 
• The SAARC Gold Cup Football tournament was a major step towards strengthening ties between **South Asian countries**.
 
• India's victory in the inaugural edition highlighted its prowess in **football within South Asia** during the early 1990s.
 
• The SAARC Gold Cup served as a platform to bring together teams from **SAARC nations**, such as India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, and the Maldives.
 
• The event became a symbol of unity and sportsmanship among **South Asian countries**.
